purpose: full-flavor EFT1 Wilson boundary tensors before one-loop running

flavor_conventions.yukawa_orientation: PL seed uses conjugated T3 Yukawas exactly as exported by Matchete

terms.flavor_kernel_wolfram: (Sum[Conjugate[y1[p, r]]*Conjugate[y2[q, r]] + Conjugate[y2[p, r]]*Conjugate[y1[q, r]], {r, 1, NF}])/(2*MF)
terms.original_term_input_form: (Bar[Coupling[y1, {Index[d$$1, Flavor], Index[d$$1, NFlavor]}, 0]]*Bar[Coupling[y2, {Index[d$$2, Flavor], Index[d$$1, NFlavor]}, 0]]*Bar[Field[NewScalar1, Scalar, {}, {}]]*CG[T3MixCG, {Bar[Index[d$$1, SU2L[fund]]], Bar[Index[d$$2, SU2L[fund]]], Index[d$$1, T3BSMd3]}]*Field[NewScalar2, Scalar, {Index[d$$1, T3BSMd3]}, {}]*NCM[Transp[Field[l, Fermion, {Index[d$$2, SU2L[fund]], Index[d$$2, Flavor]}, {}]], DiracProduct[GammaCC, Proj[-1]], Field[l, Fermion, {Index[d$$1, SU2L[fund]], Index[d$$1, Flavor]}, {}]])/Coupling[MF, {}, 0]
